before: Source-extracted delayed private invite creation reproduced an owner invite token being emitted after switching to a different actor. Pending share callbacks lacked equivalent identity invalidation.
implemented: Root synchronously invalidates share identity scopes and closes the sheet whenever Auth identity changes. Logout and sign-in to the same account also invalidate old generations; same-identity refresh remains valid.

Delayed private invite creation suppresses obsolete success/error. Share modal guards recipient resolution, sequential invite sends, public share completion, errors, external/clipboard completion and delayed dismissal against session and modal-generation changes.
Account-keyed share modal clears per-room retry cache; root callback refuses to merge messages into another account workspace.
Authenticated chat invitation redemption goes directly to the existing authorized RPC without persisting its token in the anonymous login handoff store; stale results cannot navigate.

localVerification.scope: Actual extracted callbacks plus real share-scope implementation; deferred operations cross account, logout/login, modal replacement and failure boundaries.

limitations: No production mutation or deployment. Coordinator owns final integrated gate and actual deployed acceptance.

Already dispatched authorized backend requests are not retroactively undone; guards prevent subsequent recipient dispatch and stale client delivery/navigation. Existing RPC authorization and RLS remain in force.
